title: Ivo and the Debt
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Halloran, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
